title: viseme-track/1
description: Mouth timing for ONE voiced line. Written by `uv run tools/voice.py visemes <episode>` to work/voice/<episode>/visemes/<line-id>.json from the audio envelope and the line's Arabic letters (no model). Read by visemeTrackAt(track, t) in tools/render/face.js; t is seconds from the start of the line's audio. A shot places the line at a start time and passes s.viseme = visemeTrackAt(track, shotT - lineStart). Viseme ids are the character's own (catalogue/characters/<id>/<latest>/face/face.json, ids V0..V9); V0 is rest. Each id is held until the next key; the last key is V0 at the end of speech.

face.description: <character>/<catalogue version> whose face.json letters map was used

fps.description: frame rate the minimum hold was computed at (consonant shapes hold >= 2 frames)

ramp_s.description: fade of the mouth weight w at the start and end of speech
